description: Configurable selfie state transitions and adaptive battery preparation with strict private-consumer boundaries.

routing.when_to_use: Use for configurable synthetic selfie-compliance, battery projection, bundled measurement, and image-correction preparation.
when_not_to_use: Do not use as a device, image, calendar, reminder, health, treatment, or private-ledger connector.
Do not use with real private values, images, locations, routines, identifiers, or credentials.
Do not use for diagnosis, consent inference, treatment change, or standing-rule activation.
exclusion_rules: OpenClaw owns private state, schedules, bindings, and delivery.
Platform owns identity and capability grants.

required_inputs.name: request
required_inputs.description: Synthetic request, consumer configuration, source evidence, and bounded observations.

execution.procedure_summary: Validate privacy and provenance, classify the state machine, learn bounded synthetic rates, preserve uncertainty/corrections, and return an owner-gated result.
forbidden_actions: Store or echo real private data or image bytes
Read a device or invoke a calendar/reminder/image/ledger connector
Infer consent or activate standing rules
verification_steps: Confirm hashes, no prohibited paths, no external effects, and exact rollback
completion_criteria: All required states and projections are typed
Effects are empty and private_state_writes is false
Uncertainty, owner escalation, idempotency, and rollback are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: retain synthetic IDs, evidence hashes, typed outcomes, and receipts only
